people.name: Moab

translations.web: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
translations.bsb: David also defeated the Moabites, and they became subject to David and brought him tribute.
translations.kjv: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
